data_source: ESPN historical schedules/results; StatsBomb Open Data only for separately labeled xG study
target_competition: UEFA Champions League, main group/league phase through final; qualifying excluded
historical_availability: Result/score features admitted no earlier than kickoff + 4 hours as a conservative reconstruction proxy, not a verified source publication timestamp. Date-only domestic scores are admitted from the following UTC day; no fabricated publication times.
cohort_rule: All completed target fixtures in each declared season with verified 90-minute score. Baseline comparison uses the same fixtures with at least five eligible historical team matches; report excluded/cold-start fixtures separately.
fit_schedule: Monthly walk-forward. Each fit uses only rows available at or before the earliest forecast cutoff in that month's target block. Earlier validation/test outcomes may enter later fits only according to this predeclared schedule. Hyperparameters and variant selection are frozen after validation.
selection_rule: Choose 1X2 variant by lowest validation log loss, tie-break Brier; choose BTTS variant by lowest validation Brier, tie-break log loss; choose total-goal variant by lowest validation Brier. All variants and failures reported. These are separate target models, not a claimed single joint forecast.
promotion_gate: For each target separately, the validation-selected variant must beat the last5 baseline on pooled held-out primary metric, must not worsen that target's companion proper scoring metric, and must improve the primary metric in each of the two held-out seasons. Report paired time-block uncertainty; no claim of established superiority from point estimates alone. Targets failing the gate retain the earlier baseline/research-only status. No retuning after test results.

extra_features.form: Causal rolling mean goals for/against with a league-wide training prior; compare windows 5, 10, 20; no removing large scores based on later results.
extra_features.rest: Days since last eligible covered competitive fixture and number of covered fixtures in preceding 14 days; explicit source coverage limits.
extra_features.travel: Great-circle distance from away club's previously observed home venue city to target venue city, labeled city-distance proxy; not actual itinerary. Missing coordinates remain unavailable, not zero distance.
extra_features.h2h: Causal prior competitive head-to-head goal differential in preceding three years, shrunk by n/(n+5); not counts from target or future fixtures.
extra_features.motivation: UCL phase points per game and games played as measurable standings proxies, labeled as such; no claim to measure psychological intensity or automatic +18%.
extra_features.absences: Requires historically announced status and role/minutes before cutoff; target actual lineup is not a T-24h feature. Unsupported histories remain not tested.
extra_features.markets: Requires comparable timestamped quotes before each cutoff. Undated/closing quotes cannot substitute for T-24h. Anomalies at T-30 are a distinct horizon and need independent sources.

luck_policy: User suspects Fenerbahce's win over Liverpool involved luck. Store as an unverified post-match diagnostic hypothesis. The match remains a scored loss for Liverpool's 1X2 pick; no luck feature or result exclusion.
old_cases: Previously frozen PSG-Inter and nine-match November cohort remain unchanged and are not used to select these variants.
auxiliary_xg: StatsBomb complete Premier League and Serie A 2015/16 seasons. Separate chronological study of prior-match xG features versus goals; not evidence of transfer to modern UCL. Retain single-provider definition and normal-time event scope.
